messages:
Maria: 👀 Observed a main-thread jank when opening the Heatline widget on canary (eu1). CPU main thread spike ~200-800ms on Chrome 121. Repro: load dashboard -> pick heavy project -> hover heatline.

Sasha: I can reproduce on my machine with the canary bundle. Quick inspect shows heavy sync work in a large chunk (chunk #47 ~480kb unminified).

Maria: Console trace snippet:
```
LongTask: parseChunk(47)
 at parseChunk (bundle.chunk.47.js:120)
 at hydrateHeatline (heatline.ts:142)
 at renderWidget (widget.tsx:87)
```

infra-bot: deploy notice: v0.54-canary-7 -> eu1 at 2026-03-19T09:05:00Z (sha=b3f2c9).

Jon: this correlates with the prefetch-affinity change we rolled last week. We widened the routing.prefetch.windowMs which seems to cause more eager chunk fetches; multiple chunks are landing and parsing together.

Emily: telemetry shows chunk_bytes_per_session up for the canary bucket after that change. Also found we lowered the widget perf sampling in PR#4821 so we missed many detailed longtask traces. :neutral_face:

Maria: Can we bump sampling only for Heatline so we get precise longtask counts and wall-clock timings?

Sasha: Easy. I'll open a small PR to set sampleRate=1.0 for api path /heatline in the canary config.

Praveen: Quick mitigation options? 1) shrink prefetch window in routing config, 2) parse chunks off-main-thread (worker), 3) throttle parse concurrency on client.

Jon: Routing flag is server-side: routing.prefetch.windowMs. Lowering from 1000 -> 200ms should cut down simultaneous arrivals. Safe to toggle for canary.

Maria: Do that for canary and also implement a client-side worker fallback behind a feature flag. If worker isn't available, fall back to sync parsing.

Sasha: Created ENG-heatline-462 and started WIP PR #5123. Worker stub:
```js
if (flags.heatlineParserWorker) {
  worker.postMessage({type: 'parse', chunkId})
} else {
  parseChunkSync(chunk)
}
```
I've also prototyped a small queue to limit concurrent parse tasks.

infra-bot: config change proposed: cfg-1894 routing.prefetch.windowMs 1000 -> 200 (canary). Review requested.

Emily: Approved and also pushing telemetry change PR #5130 to raise heatline sampling to 100% for canary. Adding metrics: heatline_longtask_ms and heatline_chunk_bytes.

Jon: Note: reducing prefetch will hurt cache hit rate for very short sessions and could raise tail request latency on cold loads. We'll need to monitor small-session latency and error budget.

Maria: Agreed. Plan: run canary for 2 hours and monitor these signals: heatline_longtask p95 (<100ms target), chart_paint_lcp, small-session request latency p95, and error budget burn.

Sasha: Rolled cfg-1894 into eu1 canary @09:20Z. PR #5123 includes worker + queue tests but needs small refactor. Logs for repro: https://logs.internal/repro/heatline-3543219876

Maria: Early metrics show a ~60% drop in longtask counts after shrinking the prefetch window. 🎉 But still seeing rare tail spikes when several widgets mount at once.

Praveen: That tail suggests concurrent parser tasks stacking up. Limit parse concurrency to 1 client-side and queue extras. Combined with worker mode should smooth peaks.

Sasha: Implemented heatline.parseConcurrency = 1 in the PR and added a backoff to avoid queuing storms.

Emily: New telemetry: heatline_longtask p95 fell from ~340ms -> ~120ms. chunk_bytes_per_session back down. Solid improvement.

Jon: Worker fallback adds ~18KB gzip to the payload when enabled; still within our bundle budget but call it out in release notes.

Maria: Action items: 
- Sasha: finish and land PR #5123 (worker + concurrency) behind feature flag. ETA ~2h.
- Emily: enable sampling and add a dashboard panel for heatline_longtask & chunk bytes. ETA ~30m.
- Praveen: monitor canary for 2h; rollback cfg-1894 if small-session latency or error budget degrades. Ongoing.
- Jon: produce quick rollback playbook for routing change.

Sasha: ack. Will ping here on merge and when flag flips. :eyes:

Maria: FYI we should capture this in a short blameless note/postmortem if it reaches prod. Root cause: telemetry sampling blindspot + routing tweak. I'll file the note after the canary window.

infra-bot: canary monitor update: heatline_longtask within target thresholds. Next auto-check in 30m.

Maria: Closing loop for now. PR merged to canary and flag heatlineParserWorker=true set for canary cohort. Leaving channel open for any regressions. Thanks team. :coffee:
